# Generated by tools/build_potential.py. Genes persist independently of visible traits.
ac_roll_potential_limit_effect = { random_list = {
400 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 1 } }
280 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 2 } }
180 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 3 } }
70 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 4 } }
40 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 5 } }
20 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 6 } }
6 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 7 } }
3 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 8 } }
1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = 9 } }
} }
ac_inherit_potential_limit_effect = {
 if = { limit = { real_mother ?= { is_alive = yes } real_father ?= { is_alive = yes } exists = real_mother exists = real_father }
 random_list = {
 35 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = real_mother.var:ac_potential_limit_gene } }
 35 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = real_father.var:ac_potential_limit_gene } }
 27 = { ac_roll_potential_limit_effect = yes }
 3 = { ac_reinforce_potential_limit_effect = yes }
 } }
 else_if = { limit = { exists = real_mother real_mother = { is_alive = yes } } random_list = {
 75 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = real_mother.var:ac_potential_limit_gene } }
 25 = { ac_roll_potential_limit_effect = yes } } }
 else_if = { limit = { exists = real_father real_father = { is_alive = yes } } random_list = {
 75 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = real_father.var:ac_potential_limit_gene } }
 25 = { ac_roll_potential_limit_effect = yes } } }
 else = { ac_roll_potential_limit_effect = yes }
}
# CK3 script-value min sets a lower bound; max caps the result.
ac_reinforce_potential_limit_effect = {
 set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = { value = real_mother.var:ac_potential_limit_gene min = real_father.var:ac_potential_limit_gene } }
 if = { limit = { real_mother = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene <= 3 } real_father = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene <= 3 } }
 change_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene add = 3 } }
 else_if = { limit = { real_mother = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene >= 4 var:ac_potential_limit_gene <= 6 } real_father = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene >= 4 var:ac_potential_limit_gene <= 6 } }
 change_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene add = 3 } }
 else_if = { limit = { real_mother = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene >= 7 } real_father = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene >= 7 } }
 set_variable = { name = ac_potential_limit_gene value = { value = var:ac_potential_limit_gene add = 1 max = 9 } } }
}
ac_roll_potential_talent_effect = { random_list = {
400 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 1 } }
280 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 2 } }
180 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 3 } }
70 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 4 } }
40 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 5 } }
20 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 6 } }
6 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 7 } }
3 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 8 } }
1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = 9 } }
} }
ac_inherit_potential_talent_effect = {
 if = { limit = { real_mother ?= { is_alive = yes } real_father ?= { is_alive = yes } exists = real_mother exists = real_father }
 random_list = {
 35 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = real_mother.var:ac_potential_talent_gene } }
 35 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = real_father.var:ac_potential_talent_gene } }
 27 = { ac_roll_potential_talent_effect = yes }
 3 = { ac_reinforce_potential_talent_effect = yes }
 } }
 else_if = { limit = { exists = real_mother real_mother = { is_alive = yes } } random_list = {
 75 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = real_mother.var:ac_potential_talent_gene } }
 25 = { ac_roll_potential_talent_effect = yes } } }
 else_if = { limit = { exists = real_father real_father = { is_alive = yes } } random_list = {
 75 = { set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = real_father.var:ac_potential_talent_gene } }
 25 = { ac_roll_potential_talent_effect = yes } } }
 else = { ac_roll_potential_talent_effect = yes }
}
# CK3 script-value min sets a lower bound; max caps the result.
ac_reinforce_potential_talent_effect = {
 set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = { value = real_mother.var:ac_potential_talent_gene min = real_father.var:ac_potential_talent_gene } }
 if = { limit = { real_mother = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene <= 3 } real_father = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene <= 3 } }
 change_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene add = 3 } }
 else_if = { limit = { real_mother = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene >= 4 var:ac_potential_talent_gene <= 6 } real_father = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene >= 4 var:ac_potential_talent_gene <= 6 } }
 change_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene add = 3 } }
 else_if = { limit = { real_mother = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene >= 7 } real_father = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene >= 7 } }
 set_variable = { name = ac_potential_talent_gene value = { value = var:ac_potential_talent_gene add = 1 max = 9 } } }
}
# Seed unknown parent DNA without recursively walking an entire ancestry.
ac_seed_potential_effect = {
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_potential_limit_gene } } ac_roll_potential_limit_effect = yes }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_potential_talent_gene } } ac_roll_potential_talent_effect = yes }
}
ac_initialize_potential_effect = {
 if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_potential_limit_gene } NOT = { has_variable = ac_potential_talent_gene } } }
 if = { limit = { exists = real_mother real_mother = { is_alive = yes } } real_mother = { ac_seed_potential_effect = yes } }
 if = { limit = { exists = real_father real_father = { is_alive = yes } } real_father = { ac_seed_potential_effect = yes } }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_potential_limit_gene } } ac_inherit_potential_limit_effect = yes }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_potential_talent_gene } } ac_inherit_potential_talent_effect = yes }
 }
}
ac_reveal_potential_effect = {
 if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_revealing_potential } }
 add_character_flag = ac_revealing_potential
 ac_initialize_potential_effect = yes
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_potential } } add_trait = ac_potential }
add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = -100 }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 1 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 12 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 2 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 23 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 3 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 34 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 4 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 45 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 5 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 56 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 6 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 67 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 7 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 78 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 8 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 89 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_limit_gene = 9 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_limit value = 100 } }
add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = -100 }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 1 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 12 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 2 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 23 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 3 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 34 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 4 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 45 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 5 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 56 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 6 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 67 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 7 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 78 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 8 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 89 } }
if = { limit = { var:ac_potential_talent_gene = 9 } add_trait_xp = { trait = ac_potential track = ac_potential_talent value = 100 } }
remove_character_flag = ac_revealing_potential
 }
}
ac_potential_backfill_effect = {
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = ac_potential_backfilled } }
 set_global_variable = { name = ac_potential_backfilled value = yes }
 every_living_character = { limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator } ac_reveal_potential_effect = yes }
 }
}
